name: B10-0500/2025 – § 13 – Am 10
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on protection of EU consumers against the practices of certain e-commerce platforms: the case of child-like sex dolls, weapons and other illegal products and materials
part_text: 13. Emphasises that the recent findings concerning SHEIN, Temu, AliExpress, Wish, Amazon and other e-commerce platforms demonstrate systemic failures rather than isolated incidents and cannot be remedied merely through product withdrawal or public apologies;
